stemMarkdown: The speeds of A and B are in the ratio 3 : 2. In a 400 m race, how many metres of a head start must A give B so that the race ends in a dead heat? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: In the time A covers 400 m, B covers $400 \times \dfrac{2}{3} = 266.6667$ m. For a tie, B must be started ahead by the shortfall: $133.3333$ m.
